wall-02.notes: West terrace close-up: brick arcade with white pilasters and multi-pane windows behind the arches; the upper floors are assumed to follow the four-bay rhythm seen from the street.

wall-03.notes: South (Main Street) wing: storefronts with arched display windows and fanlit doors at street level, shuttered brick floors above and slate roof with dormers; a tree hides the center.

wall-10.notes: North side facing the Green across the street: glazed ground-floor restaurant terrace, three brick floors of regular windows, dormered slate roof; the porte-cochere entrance at the right.

wall-11.notes: Northwest corner block at Main and Wheelock: four-bay brick facade over a white-columned arcade with arched openings, dormers in the slate roof.

roof.notes: Slate roof with rows of gabled dormers; modeled as a footprint-following hip without dormers.
